role: Value types for drag preview / pending ranges / pending split and the three modal sheets (Add Sleep, Carve Awake, Split Segment) the sleep timeline editor presents; sheets only collect times and call back.
types: PendingRange: struct Identifiable — start/end for add/carve sheet
PendingSplit: struct Identifiable — segment bounds + cut time
toplevel: PendingRange.id and PendingSplit.id default to UUID() at construction.

flags.text: AddSleepSheet and CarveAwakeSheet are the same view (init, two DatePickers, note, Cancel/confirm toolbar, end<=start disable) differing only in strings.

flags.text: The button enables any atTime strictly inside the segment, but applyingSplit rejects cuts within 60 s of either end (after snapping to the minute), so for a short segment where cutRange collapses to the midpoint, or a picked time that snaps to within a minute of an edge, tapping Split closes the sheet and silently does nothing.

units.does: Valid DatePicker range for the cut: [start+60s, end-60s], or the midpoint alone when the segment is shorter than 2 min.
